why: owner 28 Nov: 1.2.2 draft with the copy fix, system lines in the report, channel notices, NEW, macro window, mount tooltip

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.2.2-beta (draft) for WoW Forever 1.60.1 (game build 71139)

Fixed
- The copy buttons of the small report page no longer call the game's clipboard function. The game closes it to addons and showed a blocked action pop-up. The text is selected in the box and Ctrl+C copies it.
- System lines that no row knew did not reach the report after the list was cleared and in long sessions. They are noted again now.
- NEW on the game menu stayed English because the word NEW is also the name of a game text. Fixed.
- A tooltip of a spell-like thing outside the spell frames (a mount for example) is now read, translated when known, and logged when not.

New
- The channel notices (Joined, Left, Changed Channel) in Persian.
- The macro window texts, the auction sold line, Camp Benefits, the mount Striped Nightsaber.

From the earlier 1.2.2 drafts
- A window first shown in a fight no longer takes the keyboard. The trace and the timers in the report. The small page of the icon, update and new tags, the buffs switch with a preview, the experimental combat option, the game windows switch OFF by default.

This build is for testing in game. Nothing of the game is written, and nothing runs in combat unless the combat option is turned on.
